title: Riebeckite dataset page record
description: One record per line of pages.ndjson, emitted by @riebeckite/plugin-dataset.

slug.description: Stable internal note identifier; unchanged when the public URL changes.

permalink.description: Published URL path of the page.

date.description: Resolved publication date as an ISO 8601 datetime, or null when the note has no date.

excerpt.description: Frontmatter description when set, otherwise the leading plain text of the note, capped at 180 characters.

language.description: Language of the entry's public location, omitted when unset.
